resources.string:
1. Connect the VPN and your computer to the same Wi-Fi network, or enable phone Wi-Fi/USB tethering.
2. Select the local address and start sharing.
3. Configure the computer HTTP and HTTPS proxy using the displayed address, port and credentials.
Only proxy-configured applications use the VPN (TCP, no UDP). Use a trusted network. Sharing continues after closing this screen; stop it here or in the notification. A VPN disconnect stops sharing.
Live VPN measurement: HTTPS latency, download and upload to Cloudflare. Uses up to approximately 2.5 MB. Results depend on the network and server. You can stop at any time.
Connect the VPN first. No direct connection outside the tunnel.
Enable Wi-Fi or USB tethering and try again.
Unable to start sharing on this address.
Test interrupted or server unreachable through the VPN. Try again.
